additional_info.subject: OCPP Communication Disconnect - XF4 Router Check
additional_info.body:
Hello Siemens team,
On 08/02 around 11:30 (local time), the charger stopped communicating with the CSMS and changed from ONLINE to UNKNOWN due to more than 10 minutes without communication.
No electrical faults, protection events, or charger errors were recorded prior to the disconnect.
The last successful communication was at 09:30:51 UTC.
This appears to be a communication/network issue rather than a charger fault.
Please check the XF4 router/modem.
Thanks,
Ziv

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477192-AC/VC3/IL-(Null) OCPP communication disconnected CRM:02681001419
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
We encountered an OCPP connectivity issue yesterday on
Sicharge D, serial number 170002061
.
The routers on the SCB side were not accessible remotely, and I was unable to push a new configuration. Ziv visited the site, and I supported him remotely during the troubleshooting.
During the checks, we inspected router XF4. When attempting local access via Ethernet cable, the password was rejected as incorrect and did not match the password defined in the SCB.
This raises a concern — how could the router password change without any intervention? This behavior is very unusual.
We proceeded with a factory reset of XF4 and reconfigured it from scratch, including setting the password according to the SCB definition. After completing these actions, OCPP communication was successfully restored.
We kindly ask you to remotely access router XF3 via SSH as well. We observed that the password defined in the SCB is also not valid for XF3, even though no changes were made to this router.
Please remotely restore the correct password on XF3 according to the SCB configuration.
Best regards,
Orel
